purpose: Sanitized examples from backed-up installed settings; edit target-specific placeholders before installation.

layout.etc/: System configuration at the same absolute /etc path.
layout.home/jetson/: User configuration under the deployment account home directory.
layout.project/: Configuration relative to the project checkout.

placeholders.__CONTROLLER_MAC__: Replace with the Bluetooth controller MAC selected on the target Jetson.
placeholders.__HEADSET_MAC__: Replace with the paired headset Bluetooth MAC in colon-separated form.
placeholders.__HEADSET_MAC_UNDERSCORE__: Replace with the headset MAC using underscores as shown by PipeWire node names.
placeholders.__HEADSET_ALIAS__: Replace with the target headset Bluetooth alias.
placeholders.__PLATFORM_FINGERPRINT__: Replace with the platform fingerprint of engines rebuilt for the target Jetson; verify the full engine path exists.
placeholders.__SPEAKER_NODE_NAME__: Replace with a PipeWire output node selected on the target system before enabling optional speaker mirroring.

calibration.note: Preserved calibration belongs to the original headset/controller/profile; recalibrate when hardware or Bluetooth profile changes.
calibration.vad: Installed realtime.env Silero and RMS thresholds, start/preroll/silence/hard-cap settings preserved.

excluded_private_state: Bluetooth pairing keys and pairing database
deployment_notes: The examples do not install or start services.
Source deployment scripts retain original device defaults. Update those defaults or use supported environment settings when deploying different hardware.
The installed user PipeWire override directory contained no files; session AEC configuration is the project-relative args file included here.
The performance service preserves the captured nvpmodel mode 0 and jetson_clocks commands; select a compatible power mode for the target board before enabling it.
The web service preserves binding to all interfaces on port 8080.

changes: Speaker mirroring disabled until a valid local PipeWire output node is selected.
Removed the original USB gadget address from the comment; bind setting remains 0.0.0.0.
